I feel that this info is missed, even for some network pros. Here's a quick n' dirty for others.

100 Full-

Im set to 100 Full, you're set to 100 Full. We negotiate @ 100 Full.

Im set to 100 Full, you're set to Auto. We Negotiate @ 100 Half.

Im set to Auto, You're set to 100 Full. We Negotiate @ 100 Half.

Im set to Auto, You're set to Auto, We Negotiate @ 1Gig Full(or the highest speed avail on both cards)

10 Full-

Im set to 10 Full, you're set to 10 Full. We negotiate @ 10 Full.

Im set to 10 Full, you're set to Auto. We Negotiate @ 10 Half.

Im set to Auto, You're set to 10 Full. We Negotiate @ 10 Half.

Im set to Auto, You're set to Auto, We Negotiate @ 1Gig Full (or the highest speed avail on both cards)

So, 2 devices need to match, always.

10 vs. 100 vs. 1gig -

Im set to 100 Full, you're set to 10 Full. Link Down

Im set to 10 Full, you're set to 100 Full. Link Down

Im set to 1Gig Full, you're set to 10Full. Link Down (I could go on, but the speed needs to match, otherwise it's a down state)

Today, River Plate (Argentina) and Guaraní (Paraguay) will be playing the first match of the Copa Libertadores

Guaraní has become the fourth paraguayan team to reach the semi finals in the last 5 years, returning to this stage of the Tournament after 49 years. After finishing second in their local competition, 'El Indio'will be looking to bring the Libertadores Cup to Paraguay for the first time in the clubs history. They arrive to the match having beaten General Díaz 5-0 in the second match of the local tournament, with the certainty of having all players to their disposal, and the hope for their first Libertadores title.

After a very tough group stage, which nearly saw River Plate getting eliminated, they've reached the semifinals after a controversial attack by Boca Junior's fans, and then beating Cruzeiro in Minas Gerais. The team arrives with an air of uncertainty, after the results have left a lot to be desired. River arrives to this match after being eliminated for the Argentine Cup in the hands of Rosario Central. The roster has also suffered some changes, with Teófilo Gutiérrez leaving the team, and players like Javier Saviola, 'Lucho' González and Tabaré Viudez joining the 'millonarios' in their quest for their third Copa Libertadores' title, having won the Copa Sudamericana last year.
Copa Libertadores Semifinals Preview: River Plate Vs Guaraní
It was 2-0 for River. Next match will be in Paraguay, with Guaraní being the home team.
